description: AskSary Studio is an independent AI technology company based in Bahrain, building advanced AI platforms across intelligent productivity, generative creation and governed autonomous systems with our latest platform, AskSary Studio being unveiled at LEAP AskSary Studio, is a unified multi-model AI creation and productivity environment designed to take users from conversation to finished work without moving between disconnected applications. It brings leading AI models together with cross-device persistent memory, knowledge retrieval, real-time voice, image and video generation, advanced image editing, music and podcast creation, presentation generation, coding and AI-assisted 3D game development within a single platform.AskSary's Studio creative environment extends beyond generation. AskSary Studio provides a multitrack production workspace where images, video, voice, music, text and generated assets can be created, assembled and edited together. Specialist environments for image editing, music, video and development remain connected through persistent workspaces, allowing users to move between activities without losing their working state.An application-wide AskSary Studio Guide adds a conversational control layer across the platform. Users can describe what they want in natural language or by voice, and the Guide can explain features, navigate between tools, prepare prompts, configure forms and settings, and assist with multi-step creative workflows. For paid generation operations, users remain in control through transparent credit estimates and approval before execution.AskSary Studio also includes a project-aware AI development environment capable of opening and understanding large codebases, filtering unnecessary project noise, searching across files, proposing coordinated multi-file changes, presenting reviewable changes before they are applied, and rendering live application previews. Users can work with individual files or complete projects while retaining control over proposed edits.Persistent workspaces allow multiple activities to coexist across the platform, while editable project state and cloud storage allow creative work to be resumed rather than reduced to one-off generated outputs. This connects conversation, generation, editing, development and production into a continuous workflow.Together, these capabilities position AskSary Studio not simply as a multi-model chatbot or collection of AI tools, but as a persistent AI workspace for creation, development and production - where models, agents, files, projects and specialist creative environments can work together while the user remains in control.Alongside AskSary Studio, we are developing ARIA - Autonomous Resilience Intelligence Architecture, an AI-native security operations platform designed around governed autonomy and sovereign deployment.ARIA combines live system and network telemetry, AI Security Posture Management, identity and session intelligence, attack-path reasoning, evidence analysis, automated scanning, security reporting and autonomous response within a voice-native spatial command environment. It can operate across connected enterprise infrastructure while maintaining detailed records of its observations, decisions, actions, approvals and human interventions.At the centre of ARIA is its Trust Ladder. Rather than giving an AI unrestricted authority, individual capabilities progress from human approval through assisted and autonomous operation based on measured outcomes. Authority can be promoted only within defined governance boundaries, failures can immediately reduce autonomy, and critical actions remain subject to explicit controls. The AI cannot simply grant itself greater authority.ARIA maintains a persistent operational memory, autonomously recording security findings, scans, decisions, actions, approvals and human interventions to create an auditable history of how the system has observed and responded to its environment.ARIA is also designed for local, on-premises and hybrid AI deployment, allowing organizations with strict data-sovereignty requirements to keep sensitive operational telemetry within their own environment while using local models where required.Both platforms reflect the same philosophy: we are not interested in simply placing an AI chatbot on top of existing software. We are exploring what software becomes when intelligence, memory, reasoning, voice and autonomous action are treated as fundamental parts of the architecture.Alongside AskSary and ARIA, we are also developing an autonomous media and editorial platform for BFT Media in Bahrain, who approached us directly after discovering our work. The platform is designed to automate the content lifecycle from intelligence gathering and multilingual editorial processing through to AI-generated media, scheduling and cross-platform publishing. Rather than functioning as a collection of isolated AI tools, the system coordinates these capabilities as a continuous operational workflow.Across our platforms, the philosophy is the same: we are not interested in simply placing an AI chatbot on top of existing software. We are exploring what software becomes when intelligence, memory, reasoning, voice and autonomous action are treated as fundamental parts of the architecture.From creative AI and software development to autonomous media operations and sovereign, governed cybersecurity, we are building systems designed to make artificial intelligence more capable, more intuitive and more accountable.

Our platform helps organizations streamline sales, customer support, lead qualification, appointment scheduling, recruitment, collections, and other business operations using natural, human-like voice interactions.Designed for individuals, growing businesses, and enterprises, Xorris combines AI voice agents, inbound and outbound calling, multilingual conversations, voice cloning, CRM integrations, call campaigns, analytics, and workflow automation in a secure cloud-based SaaS platform.By leveraging advanced conversational AI, Xorris empowers organizations to reduce operational costs, improve customer engagement, increase team productivity, and scale communication without compromising quality. Whether serving a few customers or managing thousands of daily conversations, Xorris delivers reliable, intelligent, and scalable voice automation for modern businesses.

name: ZainTECH
description: ZainTECH is a regional integrated digital solutions provider, unifying Zain Group’s ICT assets to offer a unique value proposition of comprehensive digital solutions and services. The company is positioned to drive the transformation of enterprise and government customers in the MENA region by providing a center of excellence and managed solutions across the ICT stack, including cloud, cybersecurity, modern infrastructure, big data, IoT, AI, smart cities, drones and robotics, and emerging technologies.
